title: core_jpeg 2-D IDCT
description: Full 8x8 two-dimensional inverse DCT of the baseline JPEG decoder core_jpeg (ultraembedded, Apache-2.0): the row pass, a double-buffered corner-turn with four 32x32 dual-port RAMs, and the column pass, composed exactly as in the original decoder. Each pass is the factorized (AAN-style) algorithm with 4096-scaled cosine constants, time-sharing five multipliers over an 8-beat schedule, in 32-bit wrap-around arithmetic. The unmodified upstream RTL is the starting point.
flow: Yosys synthesis and OpenROAD static timing analysis on ASAP7. The gate-level netlist is re-simulated against the testbench on every evaluation: 323 coefficient blocks (directed extremes, full-range random, JPEG-realistic and sparse) streamed back-to-back on the decoder's fixed schedule, 20,672 outputs compared against a trace recorded from the upstream RTL.
footnotes: All entries were called through OpenRouter without prompt caching, so every step pays for its full input.
